title: Bound on low degree subsets of selected coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $t$ be a positive rational number, and let $arepsilon$ be a rational number with $0<arepsilon\le 1/2$. From any assignment of samples to each singleton coordinate set, form the empirically influential coordinates using the given threshold and cap. The number of subsets of those coordinates of size at most the degree determined by $t$ and $arepsilon$ is at most the corresponding family bound.
hypotheses_covered: samples are assigned to each singleton Fourier family member and each prescribed sample index
